await services.state.set("preview", { status: "prepared" }, { name: "prepare" }); return { preferred: true, strategy: "canary", zones: ["north", "south", "west"] };
const saved = await services.state.get("preview"); if (!saved.found) throw new Error("Missing preview"); return { ready: true };
await services.state.set("preview", { status: "deployed", fence: context.lock.fencingToken }, { name: "deploy" }); return { deployed: true };
const saved = await services.state.get("preview"); if (!saved.found || saved.value.status !== "deployed") throw new Error("Preview not deployed"); return { verified: true };

const cleanup = await services.state.get("cleanup"); if (!cleanup.found || cleanup.value !== 1 || context.steps.zones.succeeded !== 3 || context.steps.route.route !== "preferred" || context.steps.strategy.strategy !== "canary") throw new Error("Combined invariants failed"); return { value: context.steps.zones.succeeded };
await services.state.set("preview", { status: "compensated" }, { name: "compensate" }); return { corrected: true };
await services.state.increment("cleanup", 1, { name: "cleanup" }); await services.cache.set("cleanup", { done: true }, { name: "cache-cleanup" }); return { cleaned: true };
